# Build an offset per Sales ID from known Sales ($) values:
# for a given ID, Sales($) follows Sales YR + offset.
offset_by_id = {}
for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    sid = ws.cell(row, 1).value
    yr = ws.cell(row, 2).value
    sales = ws.cell(row, 3).value
    if sales not in (None, "") and yr not in (None, ""):
        offset_by_id.setdefault(sid, sales - yr)

# Fill only D2:D45 with literal computed values.
for row in range(2, 46):
    sid = ws.cell(row, 1).value
    yr = ws.cell(row, 2).value
    sales = ws.cell(row, 3).value
    
    if sales not in (None, ""):
        result = sales
    elif sid in offset_by_id and yr not in (None, ""):
        result = yr + offset_by_id[sid]
    else:
        result = None  # empty cell, e.g. Sales ID 1300 with blank Sales ($)
    
    ws.cell(row, 4).value = result
